video1.text: Hello, my name is Kim Gryun. Nice to meet you.
This space you’re in right now, it’s a virtual world I created with AI.
Here, we will move through this space together, and step inside an AI-generated film.
So now, if you’re ready, please tap the arrow button on the right.

video2.text: In 2013, I watched “The Secret Life of Walter Mitty,” and it struck me deeply.
Walter lived inside his imagination, but never brought it to life.
And the moment he began to turn those imagined scenes into action, his life began to glow.
That film made me wonder… will there come a day when my imagination can also become real?

video3.text: Time passed. And today, that imagination has finally become something I can make real with AI.
Starting now, we will watch my first AI film, AI Evolution.
Tap the red glowing arrow at the top to begin.

video3-IN.text: In the 1950s, the term AI, Artificial Intelligence, was first introduced.
The character you see in front of you is a visual interpretation of early AI.
As we moved into the 1980s, the term Machine Learning appeared
and researchers discovered something groundbreaking
if you guide AI and give it hundreds of thousands of examples
it can learn and recognize patterns on its own.
But the results at the time were still very limited.
Then in the early 2010s, everything changed with the development of GPU technology.
Now AI could train on billions of data points without human guidance.
And that’s when massive networks of information began to interact like neurons in a human brain.
We called this Deep Learning.
This was the moment AI truly began to open its eyes.
One of the most astonishing outcomes is that AI began to write and talk to us.
ChatGPT from OpenAI is the most well known example.
We call this Generative AI, because AI can now create content.
Even the world of art, which we believed belonged only to humans, became possible for AI
At first, AI made strange and bizarre images.
But over time, it reached the level of trained professionals.
뿐만아니라, AI는 사진과 동영상을 실제와 구분이 안될정도로
Even places that do not exist can be created as if they are real.
And now today, AI has even entered the domain where AI itself was born.
the world of programming and algorithms.
From AI assisted coding to autonomous AI agents that work instead of us
we are witnessing limitless expansion.
And now, beyond video generation, we are building virtual worlds that respond in real time.
Like Google Genie 3, where we can control a character inside video instantly
we are seeing the awakening of true interactive virtual space.
So now, standing in front of this exponential moment of AI
the real question is… What will we choose to create?
This was the first film, AI Evolution.

video4.text: This is A-Eye, a film that highlights the urgency and risks of AI development.
To watch the film, please select the glowing red arrow at the top.

video4-IN.text: We upload, view, and use countless pieces of information on the internet.
But did you know that AI has been learning from this information without permission?
Among the many debates surrounding AI, the biggest point of contention is this
AI systems train on information from the internet without explicit consent.
Another major concern is Deepfake technology.
AI can easily create things that look real but do not actually exist.
As a result, fake videos and fake news are multiplying
and the quality is improving to the point where it is almost indistinguishable from reality.
There is also the problem that copying has become far too easy.
People can use someone else’s work as reference without permission
reproduce it, and pass it off as their own with little effort.
With the right promotion, these inauthentic works can even become more popular than the originals
causing serious harm to the true creators.
This is the reality that has emerged alongside AI progress.
So what should companies do in this situation
They can build barricades against risk, just like you see on the screen now
so that only refined and 'safe AI' can flow down to users
like clean water passing through a filter.
Then what should individuals do
We should use refined AI tools to create content with real value.
If we focus on making content that benefits others
rather than sensational or mass produced content,
that value can grow into a great tree where more people gather
forming healthy communities that generate even greater value.
In truth, our culture has not yet caught up with the speed of AI.
This has been A-Eye, a film to raise awareness about the risks of AI development.

video5.text: This is our final film, a Toy Story parody told as an AI story.
This film is based on a real incident related to AI
and explores the mindset we need to have in the AI era.
If you would like to watch it, please tap the glowing red arrow at the top.

video5-IN.text: Recently, I served as a judge for an A I film competition
and I witnessed something fascinating
Just like a claw machine picking up dolls
we reviewed A I generated short films, and selected only the best works to advance into the finals.
Once we gathered all the finalists, we discovered something even more interesting.
Just like the variety of dolls you see here
the finalists were created by people from many different backgrounds.
In the end, a professional filmmaker won first place with the highest quality AI film.
But what impressed me even more was this
non professionals could now use A I to create finalist level work very quickly and very easily.
This means that with AI
anyone can now reach a high level in fields outside of their own original profession.
So the new leaders of the AI era
will be creators who can use A I to interweave many different domains on their own.
And I believe the next generation of creativity
will be the creators who combine strengths from multiple disciplines
to generate forms of content that have never existed before.
After watching all of these films
we now return to the very first space we met the place
where the poster for The Secret Life of Walter Mitty was waiting.
Just like Walter’s life began to shine when he brought his imagination into reality
I hope we, too, can turn our imagination into reality through AI
and create content that brings real value so that our lives may shine.

video1.text: Hello, my name is Kim Gryun. Nice to meet you.

This space you’re in right now, 
it’s a virtual world I created with AI.

Here, we will move through this space together, 
and step inside an AI-generated film.

So now, if you’re ready, 
please tap the arrow button on the right.

video2.text:
In 2013, I watched “The Secret Life of 
Walter Mitty,” and it struck me deeply.

Walter lived inside his imagination, 
but never brought it to life.

And the moment he began to turn those imagined 
scenes into action, his life began to glow.

That film made me wonder… will there come a day 
when my imagination can also become real?

video3.text:
Time passed. And today, that imagination has 
finally become something I can make real with AI.

Starting now, we will watch my first AI film, 
AI Evolution.
Tap the red glowing arrow at the top to begin.

video3-IN.text:
In the 1950s, the term AI, 
Artificial Intelligence, was first introduced.

The character you see in front of you 
is a visual interpretation of early AI.

As we moved into the 1980s, 
the term Machine Learning appeared

and researchers discovered 
something groundbreaking

if you guide AI and give it 
hundreds of thousands of examples
it can learn and recognize patterns on its own.
But the results at the time were still very limited.

Then in the early 2010s, everything changed 
with the development of GPU technology.

Now AI could train on billions of data points 
without human guidance.

And that’s when massive networks of information
began to interact like neurons in a human brain.
We called this Deep Learning.

This was the moment AI truly 
began to open its eyes.

One of the most astonishing outcomes is that 
AI began to write and talk to us.
ChatGPT from OpenAI is the most well known example.

We call this Generative AI, 
because AI can now create content.

Even the world of art, which we believed 
belonged only to humans, became possible for AI
At first, AI made strange and bizarre images.

But over time, 
it reached the level of trained professionals.
Not only that, AI can now generate photos and videos that are almost indistinguishable from reality.

Even places that do not exist can be created 
as if they are real.

And now today, AI has even entered the domain 
where AI itself was born.
the world of programming and algorithms.

From AI assisted coding to autonomous AI agents
that work instead of us
we are witnessing limitless expansion.

And now, beyond video generation, we are 
building virtual worlds that respond in real time.

Like Google Genie 3, where we can control 
a character inside video instantly

we are seeing the awakening of true 
interactive virtual space.

So now, standing in front of this 
exponential moment of AI

the real question is… 
What will we choose to create?
This was the first film, AI Evolution.

video4.text:
This is A-Eye, a film that highlights the urgency 
and risks of AI development.

To watch the film, 
please select the glowing red arrow at the top.

video4-IN.text:
We upload, view, and use countless 
pieces of information on the internet.

But did you know that AI has been learning from 
this information without permission?

Among the many debates surrounding AI, 
the biggest point of contention is this

AI systems train on information 
from the internet without explicit consent.
Another major concern is Deepfake technology.

AI can easily create things that look real 
but do not actually exist.

As a result, fake videos 
and fake news are multiplying

and the quality is improving to the point 
where it is almost indistinguishable from reality.

There is also the problem 
that copying has become far too easy.

People can use someone else’s work 
as reference without permission

reproduce it, and pass it off as their own 
with little effort.

With the right promotion, these inauthentic works
can even become more popular than the originals
causing serious harm to the true creators.

This is the reality that has emerged 
alongside AI progress.
So what should companies do in this situation

They can build barricades against risk, 
just like you see on the screen now

so that only refined and 'safe AI' 
can flow down to users
like clean water passing through a filter.
Then what should individuals do

We should use refined AI tools 
to create content with real value.

If we focus on making content 
that benefits others

rather than sensational 
or mass produced content,

that value can grow into a great tree
where more people gather

forming healthy communities 
that generate even greater value.

In truth, our culture has not yet 
caught up with the speed of AI.

This has been A-Eye, a film to raise awareness 
about the risks of AI development.

video5.text: This is our final film, a Toy Story parody told as an AI story.
This film is based on a real incident related to AI

and explores the mindset 
we need to have in the AI era.

If you would like to watch it, 
please tap the glowing red arrow at the top.

video5-IN.text:
Recently, I served as a judge 
for an AI film competition
and I witnessed something fascinating
Just like a claw machine picking up dolls

we reviewed A I generated short films, and 
selected only the best works to advance into the finals.

Once we gathered all the finalists, 
we discovered something even more interesting.
Just like the variety of dolls you see here

the finalists were created by people 
from many different backgrounds.

In the end, a professional filmmaker 
won first place with the highest quality AI film.
But what impressed me even more was this

non professionals could now use AI to create 
finalist level work very quickly and very easily.
This means that with AI

anyone can now reach a high level in fields 
outside of their own original profession.
So the new leaders of the AI era

will be creators who can use AI to interweave 
many different domains on their own.
And I believe the next generation of creativity

will be the creators who combine strengths 
from multiple disciplines

to generate forms of content 
that have never existed before.
After watching all of these films

we now return to the very first space 
we met the place

where the poster for 
The Secret Life of Walter Mitty was waiting.

Just like Walter’s life began to shine 
when he brought his imagination into reality

I hope we, too, can turn our imagination 
into reality through AI

and create content that brings real value 
so that our lives may shine.
